name: uxp-playground
description: Browser playground for Adobe UXP plugins: multi-file editor, approximate panel preview with mocked host APIs, linting, share links and installable plugin export.
author: ThisIsMrAli

scripts.vendor: node scripts/build-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-ps-api.mjs && node scripts/build-monaco-entry.mjs
scripts.build: npm run vendor && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
